findings: Candidate search requires both LSH stages equal, not union across stages. No exhaustive fallback; nearest neighbor recall unproven.
searchSimItem returns one positive-score neighbor, not all duplicate pairs and no duplicate threshold; ties preserve first iteration order.
Similarity mixes cosine0.5/Jaccard0.4/price0.1; domain product relatedness, not file/image identity.
computeAvgSim indexes global candidates by bucket-local loop positions j/k instead of sims.get(j/k); reported bucket quality can measure wrong pairs.
Reported std computes sqrt(sum squared deviation)/count rather than sqrt(sum/count). Static findings not reproduced.
Single test checks one neighbor index2 for fixture, not candidate recall, false positives or statistical correctness.
Keyword constructor can invoke external API Python helper when cache missing; it was not executed.

observations: DF counts every tokenizer output occurrence, not explicitly unique documents. Whether tokenizer removes repetition remains to inspect before declaring DF wrong.
TFIDF method resets DF but not words/wordcount; repeated invocation on same instance can index empty/new DF incorrectly. Static finding.
Optional text fields concatenate without separator; token boundaries can merge. Default index uses title only.
Dense vocabulary-sized array allocated for each item before sparse conversion, O(items*vocabulary) initialization work.
Item equals/hashCode use ID only and throw on null ID; mutable ID can violate hash-container key stability.
Price formula has no finite/nonnegative input validation here; delegated zero-vector cosine/Jaccard behavior remains unverified.
No production dedup library code changed or product API called.
getStrings preserves every emitted token; no set/unique operation. Thus DF loop counts token occurrences rather than document presence when repeated tokens emitted. Lucene behavior not executed here.
KStemStandardAnalyzer actually wraps PorterStemFilter, not a KStem filter; name does not identify implemented stemmer.
Token IO errors logged then partial token list returned without structured incomplete status; streams not explicitly closed.
readData replaces itemList for each item node rather than appending; multi-response JSON can retain only last parsed list.
IOException returns null, distinct empty-list contract absent; missing nodes/numeric parsing failures unchecked.
dedupID uses HashSet by ID: drops later equal-ID records, does not merge fields, and loses insertion order.
Image URL field galleryURL ignored; no image contents read or compared.
No API calls, dependency installs or original Java tests executed.
Tokenizer expected output explicitly contains repeated ipod, confirming repeated-token occurrence behavior and DF overcount issue.
Feature test checks dictionary dimension18, not DF values, weights, repeat invocation or empty vectors.
LSH test checks one fixture candidate list[1,2], not recall against exhaustive reference or stage-collision edge cases.
Parser tests cover100items,3items and empty response with dedupID=false only; do not cover dedupID=true, null IDs, malformed JSON or multi-response overwrite.
Across five actual Java test classes there are8@Test methods. Earlier registry16path-name test detection was inventory, not executed test count.
README explicitly defines nearest related product, including different settings/category/manufacturer; no exact duplicate definition.
Image graph clustering and distributed scaling are future work, not implemented image dedup capabilities.
README says default buckets3; main implementation defaults2. Referenced run.sh absent from tracked tree.
Empirical bucket plots are used to claim high-similarity pairs guaranteed same bucket; finite examples cannot establish universal recall, especially with reviewed statistics bugs.
Python helper uses Python2 urllib2, single response request, no pagination, no explicit network timeout, response size cap or atomic cache write.
Lowercase keyword cache filename and paths unsanitized; no freshness metadata, so cached search snapshot can remain indefinitely. Static finding.
No developer API config values read, API executed, or external reference papers credited as reviewed.
